subject: Data Engineering
title: Snowflake's Architecture
description: A micro-lesson that makes Snowflake's Architecture usable.

hook.text: Snowflake launched in 2014 with a radical idea: completely separate storage from compute.

buildup.text: Data lives in cheap cloud storage. Compute clusters spin up on demand, query the data, then shut down.

discovery.text: This separation lets different teams run their own warehouses on the same data without interference.

twist.text: Snowflake's simplicity made it beloved by analysts but created a new problem: runaway compute costs.

climax.text: Snowflake proved that separating storage and compute is the future of warehouse architecture.

punchline.text: Store once. Compute anywhere. Scale independently.

quiz.question: What is Snowflake's key architectural innovation?
